verdict.rationale: Docs directly describe faceted navigation with filters and live counts across categories, ranges, and attributes (brand, color, size, price) via a single query, plus a dedicated facet search endpoint for large facet value sets, matching the story closely. Community evidence corroborates faceting/filtering as production-used at scale, though none specifically stress-tests facet count accuracy or performance at scale. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of live facet counts under real filtering combinations, and detail on facet stats for numeric ranges beyond docs claims.
